cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10 FATAL_ERROR)

add_library(engine_scene)

# glad is needed to be generated by the user currently eventually, this will be
# decoupled from the opengl backend to support other APIs

include(FetchContent)

FetchContent_Declare(
  glm
  GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/g-truc/glm
  GIT_TAG 1.0.3)

FetchContent_MakeAvailable(glm)

target_sources(
  engine_scene
  PUBLIC FILE_SET
         CXX_MODULES
         BASE_DIRS
         ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}
         FILES
         engine.scene.camera.cppm
         engine.scene.prefabs.cppm
         ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/ecs/engine.ecs.components.cppm
  PRIVATE ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/glad.c)

target_include_directories(engine_scene PRIVATE ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/include)
target_link_libraries(engine_scene PRIVATE glm::glm)
target_compile_features(engine_scene PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
